contentText:
Most of the estimated 60,000 people who rushed into Ceuta have returned to Morocco since the territory's largest mass migrant crossing. Spanish authorities reported at least 72 deaths on August 2.

France 24 asked Juan Fernando Lopez Aguilar, former Spanish Justice Minister and current MEP, constitutional law professor, and jurist from the Spanish Socialist Workers’ Party how Ceuta is reckoning with the aftermath of the border surge.
